description:
Clear the Mental Clutter | Santoor | 1.5 Hours of Clear, Focused Calm

Too many open tabs - on your screen and in your head. When everything feels urgent, it gets hard to think about any one thing clearly.

This Indian instrumental music is designed to help your mind sort itself out - the bright, rippling tones of the santoor give your attention one steady thing to rest on, so the noise can settle.

Enjoy 1.5 hours of flowing santoor melodies over a soft drone, with an even, unhurried pulse and no vocals to compete with your thoughts.

Perfect for deep work, writing, brainstorming, planning, studying, reading, design and creative projects, clearing your head after meetings, an evening reset, or quiet thinking time.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Santoor with tanpura
Raga: Hamsadhwani (bright and clear)
Style: Indian classical instrumental
Mood: Clear, light, focused
Atmosphere: A tidy desk and an open evening
Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes

🎧 HOW TO USE
Start it when you sit down to think or create. Give it a few minutes - as the patterns repeat, your attention steadies. Keep the volume low enough to sit behind your thoughts. Headphones recommended in noisy spaces.

⏱ CHAPTERS
0:00 Setting everything down
9:00 One thing at a time
18:00 The noise thins out
27:00 Space to think
36:00 Ideas start to move
45:00 Deep in the flow
54:00 Light and clear
1:03:00 Connecting the dots
1:12:00 Calm, steady focus
1:21:00 A clear mind again

⏱ BEST FOR
• Deep work sessions
• Writing and journaling
• Brainstorming and fresh ideas
• Studying and reading
• Planning your week
• Creative projects
• Clearing your head after a long day
• Working from home
• Coding and design work
• Quiet thinking time
